text:
sam: Putting this here 1 - we need a runbook for the v1->v2 grace window. Main asks: tenant-visible timeline, audit log entries, and an escape hatch for customers who see regressions.

liu: Agreed. Proposal: 3-phase timeline in Console: Preview (info), Probe (simulate traffic), Enforce (switch). Each phase has explicit timestamps and opt-in toggles.

carol: For Preview, we should show only estimates (cost/error) and a small sample of failing prompts (anonymized). No routing change.

sre-eli: Probe behavior: route a shadow copy or small real cohort? Shadowing gives lower risk but misses runtime errors, real cohort gives more fidelity. We should default to shadow + limited real cohort option.

sam: Good point. Default: shadow at 100% + real cohort at 0.1% with `X-Compat-Probe: real` header for samples. Document will explain privacy scrub rules.

billing-bot: Note: billing will not change until Enforce. During Probe real cohort, we meter executed model and show "billed if enforced" estimate in UI.

liu: Console affordance: show a timeline bar with phase markers and the exact cutoff timestamp. Also include a small badge: "escape hatch" which toggles automatic rollback on X% error spike.

carol: Escape hatch defaults: rollback if 5xx rate increases by >3x or user-reported incidents > threshold. Need infra hooks.

sre-eli: We'll add `compat_event` logs: {phase, probe_id, route_outcome, error_rate, sample_size}. Also emit `audit_entry` events that the Console can fetch for tenant audit history.

sam: Audit entries need to be human-readable: "2026-03-20: Probe started by tenant via Console. Probe id=pid-123." Keep 90-day retention.

liu: UX: tenants want to see "who" initiated probes and a changelog. Console should render the audit entries inline under the timeline.

carol: For SDKs: if client pins v1 but tenant enforces v2, we must surface a warning header `X-Routed-Model: model-v2` on responses. Also include `X-Compatibility: partial` when behavior differs.

sre-eli: Telemetry keys to add: `probe_id`, `compat_phase`, `routed_model`, `routed_reason`, `audit_id`. We'll bubble these into spans.

sam: We must coordinate with billing: show "estimated monthly delta" during Preview and confirm in Enforce screen. Who owns the estimator?

billing-bot: billing-service will provide `estimate_delta(project_id, candidate_model_id)` endpoint. We will also return `confidence_level` and tokenization factor if models differ.

liu: Edge case: tenant is pinned to a custom model alias that maps to v1; when we enforce v2, we should keep alias mapping stable if possible or require explicit remap. Console should warn if alias remap needed.

carol: Add a small "compatibility score" (0-100) based on test-suite pass rate + runtime probe errors. Use it to color the timeline marker.

sre-eli: Ops: add a daily compact dump of 200 mismatches with scrubber to `s3://compat-debug/<date>/` for ML team. Retention 14 days.

sam: Legal asked to see PII scrub notes. We'll add the scrub rules to the runbook: remove prompt/user ids, hash any user identifiers, keep pseudo-random request ids for debug correlatability.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/grace-window-runbook -> staging (sha: b4c5d6e) :rocket:

liu: Next actions: (1) sam: draft runbook and PR; (2) carol: UI mockups with timeline + audit pane; (3) sre-eli: telemetry/events schema PR; (4) billing-bot: estimator endpoint stub. Let's reconvene after PRs.

carol: One UX nit: avoid scary red in the timeline until Enforce. Use amber for Probe, blue for Preview.

sre-eli: We'll add a Circuit breaker metric and ensure Console toggle can trigger immediate rollback via admin API.

sam: Thanks all. I'll create the initial issue and link designs here when ready. :thumbsup:
